QuestInfo.name: Collecting 70 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.1: 70? Well, that shouldn't be too hard...
QuestInfo.2: I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in the forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b70 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 10 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal soon...

0.0: Traveler, you've returned... I've sealed the doll that you gave me deep in the dark forest. But the #o38#s are still increasing in numbers... Can you please bring me #b70 #t4000033#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o38#s are often seen in the Dark Tree Forest near #m10002000#. Please take down #r70 #o38#s#k and bring me #b70#k #b#t4000033#s#k.

no.0: I see... I thought I could count on you for this, but if you are busy, then I understand. Please come back if you ever have a change of heart.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me #b70 #t4000033#s#k! That means you've thinned out the #o38#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you saved me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I've also gotten you some ores from the forest. Please put them to good use. So long!

mob.0: Don't forget to defeat the #r#o38#s#k as well.

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect #b70 #t4000033#s#k yet. The #t4000033# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
